decision: Will the Gold layer support historical snapshots or only the current state? (Q1)
alternatives: snapshot history in transactional_kpis and similar tables; separate snapshot fact table; current state only
rationale: Genie 2026-10-14: Canada exec reporting runs on fact_customer_segment_by_brand, customer x brand x month, 58 monthly snapshots (Jan 2022-Oct 2026); CLV 16 quarterly snapshots. Proposed Canada position (not decided): Gold holds a monthly customer x brand snapshot with history backfilled

decision: Where do derived KPIs live: pre-computed in Gold or standard formulas on building blocks? (Q2)
alternatives: pre-compute multi-report KPIs (CLV, churn, engagement) and document formulas for ad-hoc ones
rationale: Genie 2026-10-14: 5 derived KPIs in 2+ reports (retention rate, AOV, engagement rate, new repeat rate, DDX revenue); 5 in one report (CLV, In/Out flow, media addressable, campaign attribution, churn rate); formulas in SRC-0013. Proposed Canada position (not decided): Gold provides building blocks + one documented formula for the 5 shared KPIs; single-report KPIs stay in reporting

decision: Are brand_mdm_id / global_mdm_id the same IDs as brand_customer_id / global_customer_id, or different resolution stages; which one does Gold use? (Q3)
alternatives: same IDs renamed; different stages; both
rationale: Genie 2026-10-14: brand_customer_id : brand_mdm_id = 1:1 (10.5M), global_mdm_id groups to 8.0M; value check 2026-10-14: NOT the same values, two distinct ID systems mapped 1:1 via dim_customer_bridge (QST-0012). Reporting IDs are md5-hashed, crm_base IDs cleartext

decision: One Gold definition of "contactable" (Q4)
alternatives: email_contactability_key = Y or sms_double_optin = SSOI versus email_perm_status
rationale: Genie 2026-10-14: Canada rule = email_contactability_key Y or sms_double_optin SSOI; 4.95M of 8.03M (61.6%), email 4.62M, SMS 0.79M. Proposed Canada position (not decided): keep the Canada rule; Gold carries both fields

decision: One Gold definition of "engagement" (Q5)
alternatives: scorecard (click or open L12M); BAR (active_engaged_last_12_months); LiveRamp (engaged_prospects_l12m)
rationale: Genie 2026-10-14: scorecard rule (contactable + click/open L12M) = 4.13M; BAR and LiveRamp counts not given; 84% of contactables looks high (QST to verify)

decision: One Gold definition of "new buyer" (Q6)
rationale: Genie 2026-10-14: Canada 12-month new buyer key = 283K L12M, 163K YTD; no comparison with BAR or Gold yet

decision: One Gold definition of churn, and whether 12-24M and 24M+ granularity is needed (Q7)
alternatives: LiveRamp binary flags; lapsed_buyer_status_key; catalog "no purchase in last 12 months"; Damien's Is_Churn_12M_36M flag (business request, lapsed buyers segment); the current LiveRamp file already has churn_12_24_flag and churn_24plus_flag, plus Damien's Is_Churn_12M_36M (12-36 months), so three overlapping windows exist
rationale: Business request from Damien weighs more than the Genie suggestions; confirm with him whether the Genie flags (12-24, 24+) are also relevant | Genie 2026-10-14: Canada churn_status_key buckets active L12M 514K, lapsed 12-24M 383K, 24M+ 1.09M; LiveRamp flags derived from it; 12-36 not derivable from it. US lapsed_buyer_status_key (DP-0139) has 12-24, 24-36 and 36+ buckets, so all three flags can be derived (analysis). Proposed Canada position (not decided): adopt the US key, derive LiveRamp flags in the export

decision: Where Canada-specific attributes live in the shared SuperGold model (Q8)
rationale: Genie 2026-10-14: pref_language has 18 raw values, 29% unknown; Canada-only brands BIOCA, GAB; ACD = LDB; CAD; brand exclusions per use case (QST-0004)

decision: Refresh cadences the Gold layer must support: BAR monthly, CLV quarterly, campaign performance monthly, LiveRamp weekly (Q9)
rationale: Genie 2026-10-14: orders and email events daily; segment snapshot, scorecard (Monday job) and customer360 monthly; CLV quarterly. LiveRamp file weekly vs monthly source (open question)

decision: Migration path from crm_reporting / crm_base to cdp__* tables (Q10)
alternatives: dual-write period; view compatibility layer; which reports first
rationale: Genie 2026-10-14: 6 reports mapped to legacy tables (DDX Scorecard, DDX Engagement KPIs, CLV Deepdive, Campaign Performance, LiveRamp Customer 360, DDX Quarterly Figures); Buyer Analysis and BAR missing. Proposed order (not decided): Scorecard, Engagement, Campaign, CLV, LiveRamp
